main_text.l: אַרְכָּבָה f. Chald. Vehiculum: Genu, Genua.
רָכַךְ Molliri, Mollescere, Molle esse. Niphal נִרְכַּךְ Idem. Pyhal רִכֵּךְ Molle reddi, Emolliri. Hiphil הִרְכִּיךְ Emollire.
רָךְ m. Mollis, Tener: plur. רַכִּים. Fem. רַכָּה Plur. רَכּוֹת Mollia.
רָכָל רְכָל m. Negotiator, Mercator: Aromatarius: plurale, רְכָלִים. Fœm. רְכִילָה Negotiatrix.
רָכִיל m. Detractor, quasi honoris alterius Nundinator: & substantivè Detractio.
רְכֻלָּה f. Mercatura. מִרְכֻּלָּה f. Mercatus.
רְכָסִים m.p. Salebrosa, quasi hinc inde Elevata loca. רְכָסִים m. p. Latitones.
רֶכֶשׁ m. Equus vel Mulus levis & celer.
רָמָה Jacere, Dejicere, jaculari. Pihel רִמָּה Decipere, Defraudare, Fallere.
רָמָה Chald.. Idem : וְרָמוּ Et projecerunt, Dan.6.16: רְמִינָא Projecimus. Dan 3.24: וְרָמִיו Et projecerunt, ibid. v.21. Inf. לְמַרְמָה Ad projiciendum, ibid. v. 20. Ithpeal

page.notes: Hebrew forms are transcribed as best read; several vowel points and small superscript letters are doubtful, and the line of the Ithpeal entry is cut off at the foot of the page.
